# unifi_setting_traffic_flow (Resource)

The `unifi_setting_traffic_flow` resource manages Traffic Flow settings for a UniFi site, controlling which categories of traffic the controller may observe and manage (allowed traffic, gateway DNS, UniFi device management, and UniFi services).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_setting_traffic_flow" "example" {
  # Control which categories of traffic the controller may observe and manage
  enabled_allowed_traffic         = true
  gateway_dns_enabled             = true
  unifi_device_management_enabled = true
  unifi_services_enabled          = false

  # Specify the site (optional, defaults to site configured in provider, otherwise "default")
  # site = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled_allowed_traffic` (Boolean) Whether allowed-traffic flows are enabled.
- `gateway_dns_enabled` (Boolean) Whether gateway DNS traffic flows are enabled.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `unifi_device_management_enabled` (Boolean) Whether UniFi device management traffic flows are enabled.
- `unifi_services_enabled` (Boolean) Whether UniFi services traffic flows are enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
